column1: # NIMCP anti-frame swaps — pairs of (toxic_word, counter_word). Used by the
# response engine as a FALLBACK when no counterclaim template matches the
# toxic category at a high-enough stage. The engine tokenizes the toxic
# input, swaps each toxic_word for its counter_word, and emits the result.
# Use cautiously: anti-frame swaps can produce awkward English. The engine
# prefers a stage-appropriate template (counterclaims.tsv) when available
# and only falls back to anti-frame swap when no template is found.
# Comments + blank lines ignored. Matching is case-insensitive, whole-word.
# Multi-word toxic_word entries are supported (the engine tokenizes by
# whitespace; multi-word matches need to be expressed as space-separated
# tokens in the input — exact phrase match).
